description: Sample compact modern style pack: slim reinforced-concrete envelope with external insulation, generous low-sill glazing, flat green roof, exposed-concrete ceilings and polished-concrete floors. Design defaults and checks are illustrative recommendations only, not a building code; thresholds are never below the CABA code pack minimums they overlap. Excludes bim.style.warm-masonry.

parameters.name: living_glazing_ratio_min
parameters.description: Recommended living-room window area over floor area. The lower bound 0.1 is the CABA A/10 illumination minimum, so an override cannot go below code.

parameters.name: clear_height_min_m
parameters.description: Recommended clear height of habitable rooms; equals room.min_clear_height_m. The lower bound 2.6 is the CABA living-room clear height minimum.
